balls.text: Low full toss has been lifted over the bowler's head. Long-off runs left and cuts it off

Direct hit from the bowler. Sent upstairs. Bat's behind the crease as the bails light up. Was a full ball outside off that Tilak looked to drive through cover, he deflected it onto his body and then to the bowler's right. Vyshak ran across and threw it after turning
Slower ball sits up and is pulled flat over midwicket. Yorks the boundary cushion. 118ks, halfway into the pitch, angling away but well within reach
Missed out proper. Slot ball outside off at 135ks, QDK close to getting on one knee and drives, finds long-off
Doesn't get all of it but the pull goes in the gap, long-on runs to the left and cuts it off. Vyshak keeping it on the shorter side
Now even length balls are working! Back of length, close to the off-side tramline, QDK cloths a pull to midwicket
Fine four. Tilak gets low for the sweep, gets a full toss that's slightly high but he goes through with the shot and gets the ball grazes the bat and beats the keeper easily
Now Arshdeep puts on a show. Spreads his arms after delivering a 136ks yorker that tails in and hits middle and leg. Rutherford did his best to try and drive through the line, got no bat on it
Wide yorker within the off-side tramline is let go. Misjudged wide from Rutherford
Yorker curves in towards the base of off. 135ks. Poor Rutherford's getting these on tap, jams it straight
Highish full toss outside off is slapped to long-off
QDK works out the angle. Opens his stance and gets almost square-on as the low full toss arrives to him, he gets the bat low and then paddles it fine
Wide and fullish, defensive push takes it to cover
Just as good if not better. This comes in and Rutherford edges it to short third
Great yorker. Nothing Rutherford can do about it first ball. Jammed in front

Shreyas brings on elite athleticism... and showmanship! This is being checked but that looked a once-in-a-lifetime relay! Shreyas started close to the ropes, jumped back and was in mid-air as he first caught the ball... and when he threw the ball in to Bartlett. He was in a limbo but still had the strength to throw it with decent control, and right as he rose he signalled for the spotlight. Was a wide knuckle ball on a length that Hardik looked to slap. Bottom hand came off upon contact but then it was all Iyer
Yorker outside off, Hardik opens the face and looks to guide it fine. Misses
Hardik goes hard and clears long-off. Short ball angling it away outside off. Bat was swung across the chest, not much room to work with but he got a decent chunk

QDK opens IPL 2026 with a ton! Tucks his bat under the armpit as the ball beats short third to the right. Hardik had his hand up as he walked, gives QDK a hug and he removes his helmet and acknowledges the crowd. Was another wide yorker that was turned into a low full toss, QDK uses his flexibility to reverse paddle it
One bounce to deep midwicket. Not a bouncer but a yorker attempted, and missed. Hardik would've loved on at his shin before the delivery but mistimes a flick
Wide yorker again. QDK leans forward to get it on the low full toss and punch it to long-off
Forehanded with a full follow-through and limited timing. A little outside off, around head-height, Hardik toes it towards mid-off
Wide yorker, smart ploy. 132ks, QDK lunges without getting across, drives to deep cover
127ks Short ball rises just over stump height, Hardik cuts it from fourth stump to deep point
Hardik's not finding his timing. Looks to slap the short ball much squarer, hits long-off. Timeout
Goes wide, QDK hits it to deep point
Goes too square again, don't matter this time as the ball sails over backward square leg. Length ball outside off, dragged across with a pull that went from low to high. QDK into the nineties
Looked out at first but it clears long-off with ease. 104ks length ball outside off, QDK waited and belted it with a flat-bat to clear Jansen
Another one to the infielder. Very short and wide, 114ks, Hardik jumps and cuts to cover
Short and wide, cut hard, finds cover
Short again to Hardik. 132ks. Pulled into the ground off the lower-half, to deep midwicket. Touch squarer than last time
Good ball, well handled. Yorker around sixth stump, QDK uses the angle to scythe it over the infield, to deep-backward point
QDK misses another one because he's looking to go too square. Shin-high full toss angling away through fourth stump, QDK crouches and looks to lift a sweep. Misses
Hardik goes too hard with the pull, the 126ks short ball rises around neck-height at good pace. Under-edge goes towards midwicket
Super low full toss outside off, drilled with a closed bat face to long-on
Arshdeep yanks a slower length ball wide of off. Misses his line. Let go
QDK has had handy slices of luck tonight. Could've easily been caught at deep-backward point, but it goes wide to the right. One-bounce four. Was a wide full toss that QDK tried to drive over cover.
Angling away well outside off. Close to back of length at 125ks, cut to deep point
Back of length around off, tap and run towards point

Shanked, Naman gets Shashanked! 125ks Wobble ball on a length just outside off, Dhir went for a lofted straight drive on the up. Bat face opened and it went flat. Bartlett was well inside the ropes and was back-tracking even while taking it with hands above his head. Held his balance well
Wide on a length, cut to cover. 128ks

Lands safely... somehow. Went right up, landed where mid-off would've been. Stoinis ran in from cover, was late to pick the ball up. Shortish ball outside off, QDK looked to slap it off side, got a top edge
Dhir brings up fifty with a single to long-on. Raises his bat. Was a full ball at 124ks angling in, Dhir over-hitting this time. Wanted to smash it over long-on
Jansen goes for the yorker. Undercooks it a touch. Driven from middle stump to long-off
Slow ball in the slot. Angles away towards off. QDK crouches and swipes across the line, over-hits. Finds deep midwicket
Missed out. Knee-roll high full toss down leg, QDK looks to pick it up fine. Misses
Essentially swept to long-on. Dhir clears the front leg and shapes to slog but the fullish ball keeps angling away from him, so he adjusts
Overpitched on leg, flicked through midwicket
Rising short ball around head height, pulled into the ground with ease. To deep-backward square
Slower length ball angles in towards off. QDK shapes to punch through cover, plays it late to get it to short third
82ks length ball just outside off, looked to have come in a touch, punched through cover
Whipped. Not middled, goes to long-on on the bounce. Pitched up and angling in, Dhir using his wrists nicely
Inside out with a full follow-through! Got close to the pitch of the 80ks legbreak, reached out with his hands and went over extra cover
Makes room and chomps it down the ground
Connects with the conventional sweep. This is full and on leg, QDK clears his front leg to get behind the ball and goes over deep backward square leg
Pre-meditated reverse sweep. QDK wanted to go aerial, Chahal may have seen him and floated it full and wide. Beats bat
Another yorker. 131ks. QDK stands beside and squeezes the ball to backward point
Dhir checks the flick, it's aerial and flat. Goes to deep midwicket after landing outside the ring. Was a low full toss on leg
Yorker around middle, 133ks, pushed to deep point
This time, he connects! Same length and the same shot as the first ball, this was on middle stump. QDK clears the front leg and swings low to high to get it over midwicket
Slashed wide of short third. Slower one is picked by QDK, he gets low and cuts it off the fuller side of length
Big swing and a miss. Pitched up, very close to off and QDK swipes right across the line. He wanted to go over square leg
Wrong'un on off stump turning away as de Kock pushes to the offside and sets off for a run
Marginally short on off stump, he pulls to deep midwicket
Fifty for de Kock off just 28 balls. And he is playing his first match of the season. Floated on middle and leg, he pushes to long-on to get to his fifty
OUT OF THE PARK! Slower and well flighted outside leg stump,  was the wrong'un as well. De Kock sees this earlier, jumps down the track and slams it miles over deep midwicket
Misses out! Tossed up down leg, he sweeps but straight to short fine leg
Lovely running by these two. Floated on middle and leg, he works this to the on-side with soft hands and they hare back for two despite Chahal giving it chase
Full and very wide outside off, he squirts this off the toe-end of the bat to deep point
Shin-high full toss at 136.6kph on middle and leg, he whips this to deep midwicket.
Full and well outside off stump again, de Kock takes a step across and bunts it to the offside with soft hands
Width and de Kock will smash these away all evening long! Slower offcutter outside off, he waits for it and cuts in the gap between backward point and short third
Misses the reverse ramp. Slower offcutter just outside off, de Kock eyes a reverse ramp but can't connect. Is hit on the gloves
Full and well outside off stump, easy call of wide for the umpire
De Kock welcomes him back with another boundary. Full but there is plenty of width for de Kock outside off as he carves this to the deep backward point fence

Good placement from de Kock but he only gets a run for his effort. Full 135kph delivery outside off, de Kock uses the pace and with an open face of the bat steers to the right of deep point. The fielder though is alert and hares across and throws the ball back in one swift motion
Slower offcutter at 105.3kph outside off, he guides this with an angled bat to deep point
Full outside off stump, he carves this away across the turf to sweeper cover
slower offcutter and some excellent running gets them two runs. On off stump and de Kock just turns this to the on-side with soft hands
Full again on off stump, Dhir pushes to long-on with a straight face of the blade
Fullish in length just outside off, he eases to long-on
Floated on a length outside off, he pushes to wide long-off

Darted but again well outside off stump and the tramline. Called a wide again. Chahal isn't happy with the call and wants Shreyas to review. Wrong'un again pushed wider but de Kock had moved as well to his left. The third umpire says this is a fair delivery with the ball inside the guiding line. The on-field umpire reverses his call
Flatter well outside off stump, de Kock lets it go, called a wide
Six followed by four. Wron'gun dropped short outside off, de Kock hops back and thumps the pull to the left of long-on
De Kock gets into the act now! Gently tossed up on middle stump, de Kock brings out the slog sweep and muscles him over cow corner
Floated on middle and leg, he works this to the on-side for a run
Not with his first ball. Dhir welcomes him with a six down the ground. Tossed up on leg stump, he clears his front leg and smashes him straight over the bowler's head

Another chance of a run out, missed by Shreyas again. Full on off stump, he pushes this firmly to mid-off and takes off. Shreyas has a shy but misses. Think Dhir was short had that hit.  Looks like the ball has hit Shashank on the head as he was backing up. Yeah, bad bounce doing him in.  He is being tended to and is now walking off the field, holding an ice pack.
STAND AND DELIVER! Just the over MI were targeting. Back of a length ball on off stump and with not a lot of pace on the pitch that just sits up for Dhir to smash a pull over the long-on fence
Across the line for four more. On-pace short of a good length ball on middle stump, he flays it away not off the middle of the bat but gets enough power to send it racing to the deep square leg fence
Slower offcutter outside off, he taps to the offside
Shot! Legcutter on middle and leg, Dhir heaves it across the line over square leg for four more

Direct hit and de Kock was done for all money. He had given up. Full on off, he pushes this firmly to Shreyas at mid-off and takes a couple of steps. De Kock follows suit only to be sent back. Shreyas takes his time, aims with de Kock not even in the picture, but misses the direct hit
Back of a length ball angling across Dhir who rides the bounce and cuts to deep point
Short of a good length ball outside off, he taps it with soft hands to point
De Kock on the charge. Slower back of a length ball outside off, he stays still and flat-bats it up and over mid-off
Fuller outside off, he pushes to mid-off with a straight face of the bat

Oh, my word. Chahal has dropped an absolute sitter. Did he lose the ball in the lights? What was that shot though? Slower offcutter outside off, Dhir gets across and looks for a cheeky scoop. He immediately berates himself with the ball going straight to Chahal. He makes a meal of it
On a length on off stump, he pats this to the left of short third for a run

Outstanding work in the deep by Shashank Singh. Length ball on his pad that Dhir flicks away with authority. Shashank hares to his left from deep backward square, dives full-length and saves two for his team
Slower offcutter on leg stump, de Kock clears his front leg but is deceived by the lack of pace. He can only tick this behind square on the leg side
De Kock gets two more. Fuller just outside off stump, the batter swishes it away across the line past midwicket
Short of deep point. On the fuller side of length outside off, Dhir throws his bat at it and slices to Arya.

A misfield from midwicket and Dhir gets his first boundary. On a length on middle and leg, Dhir flicks it tidily to the left of Vyshak who gets both hands to it but can't make a clean stop. Such was the timing that the ball flies away to the fence
Starts off with an excellent full ball on off stump, Dhir digs it to mid-off
Oops, Dhir has to put in a dive to make it home. Length on middle and leg, he works to midwicket and sets off. Connolly is quick on the ball but misses the direct hit
Goes fuller now outside off stump, Dhir gets right behind it and defends
Back of a length ball slanting across Dhir, he gets across and punches to deep point's right for two
Ooh, good ball! On a length swinging back into Naman on middle stump, he works this to midwicket

SKY comes, SKY falls. Wicket No. 101 did not take much time for Arshdeep. Plenty of swing on the 136.9kph length ball angling across Suryakumar. He looks for a drive, can only manage a thick outside edge that goes to Chahal at short third. Arshdeep is on a celebratory run

A 100 IPL wickets for Arshdeep Singh! One fielder in the deep on the legside and Rickelton has found him to perfection. Was a hit-me delivery but Rickelton can't cash in. Arshdeep won't mind it one bit. Length ball on his pad which Rickelton could have smashed anywhere. He picks it cleanly but only as far as Shashank at deep backward square leg who takes a simple catch
Another short of a good length delivery outside off, he looks for a cut and mistimes his cut to short third
Ooh, cuts him into half almost. The ball also doesn't carry to the keeper. Short of a good length on off decking back into de Kock and going past his inside-edge
Length on off stump, he prods half-forward and defends
More runs. Length ball down leg, de Kock misses the flick but the ball catches his pad and rolls past the keeper
What a start to de Kock's IPL 2026! He's climbed into that. On a length angling away from de Kock outside off. He goes up and over covers and sends it all the way for a huge six
Full outside off, he mistimes a drive to the left of extra cover for a run
Just a run of the opening over. Top stuff from Arshdeep. On a length nibbling away from Rickelton outside off. He opens the face of the bat and steers to deep point
Five dot balls! Full outside off, he leans forward and drives on the up to extra cover
And again! On the fuller side of length shaping away from Rickelton outside off. He prods forward and eyes and on the up drive, but can't lay a bat on it
Beaten again! Goes fuller now, with the ball shaping away late. Rickelton pushes at it and only connects at thin air
on a length on off, nibbling away from the batter. He opens the face of the bat and guides to short third

Lots of seam movement for Arshdeep first up. Lands the ball on a length just around off and gets it to shape away late, past Rickelton's outside edge who reaches out to have a feel of the ball. Gets beaten
Oh, it's over already. Full ball outside off, Stoinis swung through the line, looked to go off the inside half of the bat but it was quick through the outfield and bisected long-on and deep midwicket
This is wide from all angles. Close to the return crease. Let go
French cut goes fine. Stoinis' bottom hand came off as he looked to drive through cover, the slow full toss outside off took the inside half and nearly took out off stump
Short and slow outside off, Stoinis cuts and ball goes well above bat
Stoinis moved so far across but still gets a wide. Shortish ball went just wide of the tramline, Stoinis shaped to cut and left it alone
Shardul unrelenting with his yorker attempts. Goes at middle stump and is driven to long-on
Very low full toss around off. Bat face opens as Prabhsimran looked to drive it hard, finds long-off
Low full toss on leg is punched to long-on
Even Jansen on a ladder over Stoinis' shoulders wouldn't have got to that. Short ball with tennis ball bounce goes way over the head. Easy leave and call for the ump

Drop costs 12 but Dhir takes a stunner to dismiss Shreyas. Ran in from deep midwicket, took the ball low and slid straight into the ground. Was a 133ks full ball on leg that was flicked flat. Shreyas walks back after his third fifty of the comp
Shades of MS Dhoni's 2011 final six, second tier too! Slot ball at the body, Shreyas whips it high and far over wide long-on. 99 metres
Should've been a catch, Dhir was a few steps in from the deep midwicket boundary. Got his hands up and the ball burst through the fingers. Was a short ball that was pulled flat

Slower ball finally beats bat. Lands very short, slants in (so no turn) and goes over off. Prabhsimran cleared his front leg and swiped as early as he did hard. No wickets for Bumrah again, he's gone over ten too. Laughs as he passes his skipper
At the body, hurries him up as Shreyas tries to defend straight. Inside edge goes leg side
Shreyas making it look easy again. Flicks a yorker through midwicket to get to fifty. Subdued celebrations
Short offcutter at chest-height around off is upper cut to deep third
Yorker slanting into leg, flicked to deep square leg
Slower one has Shreyas get into the pull a touch too early, but he was able to adjust and drag it over square leg for a one-bounce four
Pitched up at the stumps, jammed to long-on
Yorker on off, batter showed all three stumps and jammed it with a cross-bat to long-on
Yorker just outside off, chomped towards cover point
Full and flat around off, 134ks, driven to long-off
Short ball going over the head. Prabhsimran gets cramped for room, so he squatted and got low
Slot again, launched this time. Sails over long-off. Slower one but it comes on to the bat at an even pace
Drilled over the bowler. Hardik going for the yorker and misses, the slot ball is driven straight with mid-off in
Very low full toss on leg, flicked to deep-backward square
Edge flies, deep third is fine and stops it. Full ball outside off, Shreyas went hard for the cover drive
Dug in much shorter, Shreyas shapes to ramp but lets it go
Shreyas wallops Bumrah. 132ks shortish ball rises around rib-height, dragged from outside off with a pull that sails over deep midwicket
Full outside off, driven to deep point
Slower yorked missed, Prabhsimran doesn't. Leans to get low and smears the full toss through cover.  Rickleton slides on the infield, dew making it quite a sight
Yep, free hit is at the base of off stump. Prabhsimran clears the front leg and clinks a drive to cover
Shortish ball angling in as Shreyas went across is guided to deep third. Bumrah has overstepped too
Makes room and gets followed by a full ball. Driven hard but off the inside-half of the bat to long-on
Low full toss outside off, driven to deep point
On leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket
Hit-me ball has been whacked. Well down leg, fullish length. Shreyas sweeps it on the rise without getting on one knee. Gets it to short fine leg's left
Full outside off, driven to long-off. 97ks
Prabhsimran follows his captain. Goes across the crease to get inside the line. Uses the angle of the length ball coming in at the front knee-roll and lifts it fine
Goes back and pulls to deep midwicket. 121ks dug in very short, doesn't rise much or stick in the pitch
Better from Shardul. Watches Shreyas go across again and follows him with a low full toss at 133ks. Flicked through mid-on
Slapped over extra cover. 121ks length ball over the tramline, Shreyas goes back in the crease and then across to get in reach and flays it with an open face
Length outside off, punched to long-off off the back foot
Pulled to bring up fifty. Raises his bat and gets a hug from his skipper. Shortish ball outside off, pulled into the ground, wide of long-on
Way wide. Reaches out again and gets beaten on the cut

Not sure why short third didn't dive there. Ghazanfar thought it was going through cover, ball was close to his left and rolled away. Shortish ball outside off, Prabhsimran made room and slashed. Got an edge
Short of a good length ball outside off, he steers this but can't beat backward point
On a length on his pad, and these are easy pickings for Shreyas who works him neatly to the right of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
On-pace length ball on middle and leg, he clips it neatly to deep midwicket
Too much width and Prabhsimran gets four more. Slower short of a length ball outside off, he ramps this over short third
Just past a diving extra cover. Slower offcutter outside off stump, Prabhsimran gives himself a little room and hammers this aerially to the left of a flying Rutherford
on a length outside off, he punches on the rise to deep cover

The non-striker stumps save two runs, at least. Low full toss on off stump, he thumps this back to the right of the bowler. He bends low but doesn't get a finger to it even as the ball hits the stumps. Think Prabhsimran was inside the crease anyway
Quicker length ball on middle and leg, he stays back and turns this to deep midwicket
Bumrah dives and saves a couple of runs. Darted down leg, he works this to the right of short fine leg, where Bumrah does well
Slightly slower on middle and leg, he works this towards deep midwicket for a run
Fuller outside off, he eases this to long-off
Flatter on a length on middle and leg, he works this to the legside but close  to the bowler who sprints across
Short of a good length ball on off stump, he works that to the on-side for a run
Shreyas almost bunts that straight to the fielder. Slower bouncer outside off, he wanted to ramp that fine, only manages to glove it perilously close to the incoming backward point fielder
Banged in short on off, he pulls to the left of deep backward square leg. Shreyas wanted the second but is sent back
More runs! Chahar is travelling today. Length ball on his pad, he works this neatly to the left of short fine leg
Humongous! Prabhsmiran has treated Chahar like a spinner and smoked him for a 90m six. In the slot outside off, he charges down the track and tonks him over wide long-off
Slower short of a length ball at 121kph outside off, he pulls to the left of deep square leg for a couple of runs

Shardul is exclusively bowling slower deliveries. Another slower knuckle ball, which was back of a length outside off stump at 119kph. Shreyas wants to cut that away, but can only inside-edge to the keeper
Slower back of a length ball at 117.3kph outside off, he pats this to backward point who dives to his left but can't prevent a run
Chips it in the air but well short of long-off. Slower knuckle ball at 117kph and Shreyas was deceived all ends up. On the fuller side and Shreyas is early into his chip
Swing and miss and that's called a wide again. Slower back of a length ball well outside off, Shreyas throws his hands at it but can't reach it
Fuller outside off, he drives firmly all along the turf to long-off
Slower back of a length ball but it's well outside off stump. Prabhsimran misses but that's a wide

Fuller outside off stump, was the slower ball again delivered at 119.5kph. He wants to blast this through covers but the bat turns in his hand. He still collects two with the ball going to the right of deep cover
Almost gets a wicket first ball. Slower bouncer over Shreyas' head on off. He ramps it and ball almost goes to deep third
CRACKED! Rising back of a length ball outside off, he rides the bounce and sends it crashing through covers
Slower short of a length ball on off stump, he rises with the bounce and bunts this to backward point
Another sharp bouncer, he ducks under
Banged in short on off and middle, he pulls and gets a bit of a top-edge. The ball lands well short of deep backward square leg

A sloppy misfield and Shreyas gets four when he should have just one. Short of a good length ball outside off stump, he opens the face of the bat and steers to Ghazanfar who lets it through at deep third
On a length slanting back into Shreyas on middle, who pushes to midwicket
A touch slower through the air at 91.8kph on leg stump, he works this to deep backward square leg for a run
Flatter on middle and leg, he stays back and works this past midwicket for a couple of runs
What a STUNNING cover drive to get off the mark! In the slot outside off, Iyer frees his arms and absolutely smokes him through covers

Edged and taken! Ghazanfar has two in two overs. Off the front of the hand on the fuller side off. Connolly looks to drive, but the ball catches the inside-edge and de Kock does the rest. Connolly doesn't think he is hit it though, goes to consult his partner, who sends him on his way
Fuller outside off, he drives to extra cover who does well
PICKED away for SIX! Darted down leg at 101.9kph and this is easy peasy for Connolly. A flick of the wrists and he sends it away over deep backward square leg
Attempted yorker goes wrong but Connolly only gets a run for that. Shin-high full toss outside off, Connolly slices this to deep point
Good deception from Hardik. Slower bouncer at 111.9kph just around off stump. Connolly sways outside the line of that
Flat-batted for six! Back of a length ball outside off stump, Connolly stays still and hammers this over mid-on and generates enough power to clears the ropes
Fuller in length on the stumps, he pushes back to the bowler
Rubbing salt into the wounds. On-pace length ball angling across Connolly who opens the face of the bat and guides this in the gap between backward point and short third

Bumrah has put down a sitter at backward point. Oh, dear, how costly will that prove to be? Slower back of a length ball outside off. The ball gets big on Prabhsimran who can't keep his cut down. Goes to the left of Bumrah, who spills it
A run and a wicket. Top start from Ghazanfar. Marginally short on off stump, Connolly punches this with power but only as far as Hardik at extra cover
This is good bowling. Flatter on leg stump, he can only push this to covers
Quicker length ball on leg stump, Connolly is legside of the ball but only works it to midwicket
Flatter angling into the batter, who punches to extra cover

Whisked straight to midwicket and Ghazanfar draws first blood for MI. Darted at 98.8kph on the fuller side on middle and leg. He looks to go up and over but only manages shank it to Chahar, who takes a comfortable catch.
Flatter on middle and leg, he tucked to the on-side for a quick run
Excellent comeback from Bumrah. Four straight dots to Arya. Was an on-pace 141.4kph length ball on middle stump, which Arya only ticks to midwicket
Another slower length ball on off stump, he opens the face of the bat and guides but only as far as point
Swing and a miss. Full, angling away from Arya outside off stump, he looks for a drive but only connects at thin air
Slower length ball at 117kph on middle and leg, he works this to midwicket
HELPED away with precision. Back of a length ball on his hips, too straight and he just picks this through the square leg region
Length on his pad, Prabhsimran works this neatly to deep backward square leg
These are easy pickings for Arya! Banged in short on off and middle, was the knuckle ball. The ball just sits up for Arya to get into position nice and early, swivel and pull over midwicket
Wayward length ball down leg, called a wide
CARVED AWAY FOR SIX! What hands from Arya. On a length shaping away from Arya but the width was the key. He frees his arms and sends that soaring away over deep point with minimum of fuss
On a length outside off, nibbling away, he drives on the up with an angled bat to deep point

Timing supreme, placement even better! Short of  a good length ball shaping away from Prabhsimran outside off. He opens the face of the blade and plays the ball late enough to steer it past deep point
Picked away for four. Poor length ball on his pad, he nonchalantly clips this through midwicket to get off the mark in style
Gets some movement early on but Arya is up to the mark. Length ball with a hint of nibble back into Arya on middle, he presents the full face of bat and pushes straight down the track
